question: What is the M.Tech tuition fee?
expected_answer: Rs 35,000 per semester for general category M.Tech (Full-time) students admitted in 2025-26 (SC/ST pay only the Rs 1,000 registration fee)

question: What is the tuition fee per semester for full-time PhD students admitted in 2025-26?
expected_answer: Rs 7,500 per semester (general category)

question: What is the B.Tech tuition fee per semester for students whose family income is above 5 lakh?
expected_answer: Rs 62,500 per semester (2025-26)

question: How much is the refundable institute caution money for M.Tech students?
expected_answer: Rs 15,000, one-time payment at admission, refundable

question: What is the annual group insurance fee for M.Tech students?
expected_answer: Rs 787.06 per year (2025-26); it was Rs 765 in 2024-25

question: What was the total fee for the first (odd) semester for a general category M.Tech full-time student admitted in 2024-25?
expected_answer: Rs 71,815 (Total A+B+C+D, odd semester, general category, session 2024-25)

question: What is the tuition fee for M.Tech DASA students from SAARC countries?
expected_answer: US $4,000 per semester (US $8,000 for non-SAARC countries)

question: What was the tuition fee for full-time PhD students admitted in the session 2023-24?
expected_answer: Rs 7,500 per semester (general category)

question: What is the CGPA to percentage conversion formula?
expected_answer: % Marks = CGPA x 10 (2016 office order, replacing the earlier formula)

question: What CGPA to percentage conversion formula did MNIT use in 2014?
expected_answer: Equivalent percentage = (CGPA - 0.5) x 10 (written as (CGPA-0.5)/10 x 100%)

question: What CGPA is treated as First Class for MNIT Jaipur graduates for employment or recruitment purposes?
expected_answer: A CGPA of 6.0 or above

question: What is the CGPA requirement for direct PhD admission for B.Tech students?
expected_file: Revision of CGPA req from 9 to 8 for direct admission to PhD for BTechB.Arch qualified students.pdf
expected_answer: CGPA 8 (reduced from 9 by the April 2021 order; only graduates of CFTIs / NIRF top-100 institutions are eligible)

question: What is the minimum CGPA for semester promotion and award of the M.Tech degree for students admitted from 2021-22 onwards?
expected_file: CGPA requirement for semester promotionand award of degree in PG programmes.pdf
expected_answer: 5.5 for both semester promotion and award of degree

question: What minimum CGPA was required for the award of the M.Tech degree for students admitted in the session 2020-21?
What is the minimum CGPA required under the MNIT Scholar Scheme for admission to the PhD program?
expected_answer: 8.5 on a 10-point scale (8.0 for SC/ST); open to the top 10% (15% SC/ST) of MNIT B.Tech/B.Arch graduates of the last three years

question: What minimum CGPA must a first-year B.Tech student have at the end of the second semester to be promoted to the third semester?
expected_answer: A minimum CGPA of 5 at the end of the first year (otherwise year back)

question: According to the 2016 amendment to the UG regulations, how many credits must a student earn by the end of the first year to continue registration?
expected_answer: At least 30 earned credits (including supplementary examination); otherwise academically deficient (year back or termination)

question: What is the maximum number of semesters allowed to complete a B.Tech degree?
expected_answer: 14 semesters (16 for B.Arch); maximum duration eight years from admission

question: What is the minimum attendance required for a UG student to appear in the end-term examination?
expected_answer: 75% of the total classes held in the course

question: What is the maximum duration of a full-time PhD for a student admitted with a PG degree?
expected_answer: 10 semesters (may be extended by the Senate up to 14 semesters)

question: How many examiners from within the country and from outside the country must a PhD supervisor propose for the thesis evaluation board?
expected_file: Guidelines for constituting the thesis evaluationboard by PhD Supervisor.pdf
expected_answer: Four examiners from within the country and four from outside the country

question: Under the 2020 amendment, when can a full-time PhD student convert to part-time without considering the distance of the place of posting?
expected_answer: After completing the residency requirement, passing the comprehensive examination and giving the state-of-the-art seminar satisfactorily

question: What document must a PhD student working more than 70 km from Jaipur submit from the employer to convert from full-time to part-time?
expected_answer: A letter of consent from the employer (replacing the earlier NoC), in the approved format

question: What is the internship duration for PG students?
expected_answer: III semester (May 15 - Dec 31); an offer of more than 6 months up to one year may span the III and IV semesters

question: What is the upper cap on the number of one-year (VII and VIII semester) internships for B.Tech students?
expected_answer: Not more than 20% of the total class size

question: What is the maximum program duration for a full-time M.Tech?
expected_answer: 3 years (minimum residency 1 year)

question: What is the maximum tenure of the Chairman SUGB?
expected_answer: 2 years (same for Chairman SPGB)

question: In clause 13.5 (Exit Options) of the UG Regulations 2024, what was 'B.Sc. (Engg.) Degree' replaced with?
expected_answer: "B.Sc. Degree" (Senate 59th meeting, July 2025)
